notes.title: Update 1.2.1.0 on December 14, 2024
notes.content:
Update 1.2.1.0 on December 14, 2024



1. Archiving can be separated and saved separately.

notes.title: December 7, 2024 1.2.0.9 Update
notes.content:
December 7, 2024 1.2.0.9 Update

1. There is a problem of chaotic saving after saving too many files.
2. Failure to switch between walking and running.
3. The resolution UI does not display when starting the game.
4. To address the issue of shortcut key conflicts during faster descent, the x key has been changed to increase the descent speed..
5. Terrain editing is still open during construction.
6. Update the flying sword material and add flying sword actions.

notes.title: December 1, 2024 1.2.0.8 Update
notes.content:
December 1, 2024 1.2.0.8 Update


1. Sword flying instead of jumping, shortcut keys: F： Switch flights.

2. Add editing functions to the terrain, such as building mountains, digging pits, digging holes, leveling the land (note that it is not in the traditional sense, it can be sloped flat), smoothing the terrain, etc. Shortcut keys: Left click to raise terrain, Shift+left click to dig pits, dig holes. T： Switch terrain tools.

notes.title: 1.2.0.7 Update 2024.11.22
notes.content:
1.2.0.7 Update
1. Improve translation
2. Modify some materials
3. Fix the sticker and it is now usable.
4. Modify the ground to not allow mouse selection to avoid accidental clicking.
5. Add character bounce function, shortcut key F, to quickly drop, shortcut key: Shift+F.
6. The game interface can be completely hidden.
7. Repair the coordinate axis.

notes.title: Repair optimization
notes.content:
Fix:
1. The memory of outline panel entries and contents was not cleared in time and was deleted by mistake.
At the beginning of the game, you can turn on the build mode.
3. Automatic archiving has been turned off
4. Auxiliary lines cannot be hidden.
5. The pedal material is incorrect.
Optimization:
1. As long as the archive file exists, it will be directly displayed when clicking on the path. Click on import to complete the process. If you want to choose other, you need to delete the archive files in this path.
2. Several shortcut keys have been modified. The character is detached from N, teleported to the mouse position Ctrl+N, and in construction mode: move the field of view to select the coordinate axis N, teleport to the mouse position Ctrl+N, quickly save G, move the camera up Z, and move the camera down X.
3. Added overhead light, which can be turned on when entering the fake cave, with the shortcut key O

notes.title: 1.2.0.5 Update
notes.content:
Added 6 major categories of plants and some small items.
Fix the following issues:

1. Game crashes caused by weather systems.

2. The issue of shadows in high-quality images.

3. Camera shake issue in first person and reduced speed while walking.

4. Material issues.

5. Remove the basic lighting from the saved file.

notes.title: BUG handling
notes.content:
1. Handled the issue of shadow anomalies

2. Camera shake issue in first person, resulting in reduced speed while walking.

3. Add 6 types of plants.

4. Other issues.

notes.title: Fixed some issues.
notes.content:
Fix the following issues:
1. The template cannot be opened when it is not in Chinese.
2. Move the auxiliary box to ACTOR without any response.
3. Partial extension without material.
4. The size of the roof ridge and corner ridge does not match.
5. Background appears during game settings.
6. Image quality decomposition settings.
7. Some weather settings are missing.

notes.title: Add weather system, change characters, and modify character animations
notes.content:
1. Add a weather system with preset settings and customizable weather, sky, rain, snow, lightning, rainbow, aurora, and more. Over 200 parameters can be customized (for indoor rain obstruction, you need to add the "block rain" feature in the terrain and adjust the size to include the entire house).
2. Replaced the character and corrected the character animation.
3. Partially optimized the texture.
4. Fixed some minor bugs.
